## Imports
### palette and metadata

```{r}
names(palette) <- palette_df$label
```

```{r}
sample_metadata <- read.csv("metadata/clean/metadata_combined.csv", header = TRUE, sep = ",", stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
core_mdata_cols <- c("patient_id","sample_id", "phenotype", "batch", "is_surgery","surgery_type" ,  "bmi",
                     "gender","age","phenotype", "is_current_smoker", "is_ever_smoker")
core_mdata <- sample_metadata %>% select(all_of(core_mdata_cols)) %>% #rename(sample = sample_id) %>%
              mutate(phenotype = factor(phenotype, levels = c("Classical FAP", "Non-classical FAP","Fatty Liver","Control" )),
                     is_fap = phenotype %in% c("Classical FAP", "Non-classical FAP"))
```


### genus distance matrix

```{r}
path <- paste0("qiime/combined/6_Taxonomy_GTDB_v11/feature_table.tsv")
relab<- read.table(path , header = TRUE, sep = "\t")
genus_norm <- relab %>% filter(stringr::str_detect(taxon , ";g__.+", )) %>%
               tibble::column_to_rownames("taxon") %>%  mutate_all(~ . / sum(.))
colnames(genus_norm) <- format_sample_ids(colnames(genus_norm))
```

```{r}
fap_samples <- core_mdata %>% filter(is_fap) %>% pull(sample_id)
non_fap_samples <-  setdiff(colnames(genus_norm), fap_samples)
genus_norm_non_fap <- genus_norm %>% select(non_fap_samples)
```

```{r}
fatty_liver_samples <- core_mdata %>% filter(phenotype == "Fatty Liver") %>% pull(sample_id)
non_fatty_liver_samples <-  setdiff(colnames(genus_norm), fatty_liver_samples)
genus_norm <- genus_norm %>% select(non_fatty_liver_samples)
```

## Functions
plot PCoA plots, colored by (a) phenotype and (b) highlighting pairs of samples belonging to the same patient
```{r}
plot_pcoa_2d <- function(dist_df, core_mdata, palette,  x_var = 1, y_var =2,
                         shape_var = "batch", dist_metric = "", return_plots = FALSE){
  pcoa_df <- get_pcoa(dist_df, 2)
  eig_vals <- pcoa_df[[1]]
  pcoa_df <- pcoa_df[[2]] %>% left_join(core_mdata, by = "sample_id")
  
  multi_sample_patient = pcoa_df %>% count(patient_id) %>% filter(n>1) %>% pull(patient_id)
  pcoa_df <- pcoa_df %>% mutate(patient_cat = ifelse(patient_id %in% multi_sample_patient, patient_id, "single_sample"))
  # Plot PCs 1 and 2 by phenotype
  ggp1 <- ggplot(pcoa_df,aes_string(paste0("axis_", x_var), paste0("axis_", y_var), color = "phenotype", shape = shape_var)) +
      geom_point(size = 2, alpha = 0.7) + 
     ggtitle(paste0('PCoA ',dist_metric,'(Axes ',x_var,' vs. ',y_var,')')) +
      xlab(paste0('Axis ',x_var,' (', eig_vals[x_var], '% variance explained)')) +
      ylab(paste0('Axis ',y_var,' (', eig_vals[y_var], '% variance explained)')) +
      theme_classic() +
      theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5)) + 
      scale_color_manual(values = palette) 
  plot(ggp1)
  
  
  # Plot PCs 1 and 2 by patient and batch
  ggp2 <- ggplot(pcoa_df,aes_string(paste0("axis_", x_var), paste0("axis_", y_var), color = "patient_cat", group = "patient_cat", shape = shape_var)) +
      geom_point(data = pcoa_df %>% filter(patient_cat == "single_sample"), size = 3, alpha = 0.5, color = "grey") +
      geom_point(data = pcoa_df %>% filter(patient_cat != "single_sample"), size = 3, alpha = 0.7) + 
      geom_line(data = pcoa_df %>% filter(patient_cat != "single_sample")) + 
      ggtitle(paste0('PCoA ',dist_metric,'(Axes ',x_var,' vs. ',y_var,')')) +
      xlab(paste0('Axis ',x_var,' (', eig_vals[x_var], '% variance explained)')) +
      ylab(paste0('Axis ',y_var,' (', eig_vals[y_var], '% variance explained)')) +
      theme_classic() +
      theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5))
  plot(ggp2)
  if (return_plots){
    return(list(pcoa_df, ggp1, ggp2))
  } else {
  return(pcoa_df)
  }
}
```

## Analysis
### Sample PCoA plots of all genera, based on Bray-Curtis dissimilarity.
Plot the metagenomic samples according to their phenotype (indication + severity) and batch (sequencing run).
Samples with similar taxonomic profiles should be close to each other in this plot. 


```{r}
genus_dist <- vegan::vegdist(genus_norm %>% t(), method = "bray") %>% as.matrix()
pcoa_df <- plot_pcoa_2d(genus_dist,core_mdata, palette, dist_metric = "Bray-Curtis")
```



### Process samples with more than one sample per patient
Calculate the mean relative abundance of each genus for each patient (effects only patients which have more than one sample).
```{r}
calculate_patient_mean <- function(pcoa_df, data){
  sample_map <- pcoa_df %>% filter(patient_cat != "single_sample") %>% select(sample_id, patient_id, batch) 
patient_data <- data %>% select(all_of(sample_map$sample_id)) %>% t() %>% as.data.frame() %>% 
                    tibble::rownames_to_column("sample_id") %>%
                    tidyr::pivot_longer(cols = -sample_id, names_to = "name", values_to = "val") %>%
                    left_join(sample_map, by = "sample_id")
patient_data_mean <- patient_data %>% group_by(patient_id, name) %>% summarise(mean_val= mean(val)) %>%
                         mutate(patient_id = paste0(patient_id,"_mean")) %>%  ungroup()
patient_data_mean_wide <- patient_data_mean %>% tidyr::spread(name, mean_val) %>% 
                              tibble::column_to_rownames("patient_id") %>% t() %>% as.data.frame()
return (patient_data_mean_wide)
}
```

```{r}
sample_map <- pcoa_df %>% filter(patient_cat != "single_sample") %>% select(sample_id, patient_id, batch) 
patient_genus <- genus_norm %>% select(all_of(sample_map$sample_id)) %>% t() %>% as.data.frame() %>% 
                    tibble::rownames_to_column("sample_id") %>%
                    tidyr::pivot_longer(cols = -sample_id, names_to = "genus", values_to = "ra") %>%
                    left_join(sample_map, by = "sample_id")
patient_genus_ra_mean <- patient_genus %>% group_by(patient_id, genus) %>% summarise(mean_ra = mean(ra)) %>%
                         mutate(patient_id = paste0(patient_id,"_mean")) %>%  ungroup()
patient_genus_ra_mean_wide <- patient_genus_ra_mean %>% tidyr::spread(genus, mean_ra) %>% 
                              tibble::column_to_rownames("patient_id") %>% t() %>% as.data.frame()
```
### Plot the relative abunance Spearman correlation between samples of the same patient in different batches 
```{r}
manual_corr_calc_for_plot <- function(df){
    corr_lab <- df %>% group_by(patient_id) %>% 
                       summarise(cor_test = list(cor.test(`Batch 22`, `Batch 24`, method = "pearson")),.groups = "drop") %>%
                        mutate( r_raw = sapply(cor_test, function(x) x$estimate),
                                r = paste("R =", round(r_raw, 2)),
                                pval = sapply(cor_test, function(x) x$p.value),
                                fdr = p.adjust(pval, method = "fdr"),
                                p_string = ifelse( fdr < 2.2e-16, "p < 2.2e-16",
                                                   paste0("p = ",
                                                   formatC(fdr, format = "e", digits = 2))),
                                label = paste0(r, "\n", p_string)) %>%
                      select(patient_id, label, r_raw, fdr) %>% unique()
    return (corr_lab)
}
```


```{r, fig.width=12, fig.height=6}
ggdata <- patient_genus %>% select(-sample_id) %>%  tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = batch, values_from = ra) 
corr_lab <- manual_corr_calc_for_plot(ggdata)

print( corr_lab %>% summarise(mean(r_raw)))

ggp <- ggplot(ggdata, aes(x = `Batch 22`, y = `Batch 24`)) + geom_point() + 
       geom_abline(intercept = 0, slope = 1) + 
       scale_x_log10() + scale_y_log10() +
       facet_wrap(~patient_id, scales = "free", nrow = 3) + 
        geom_text(data = corr_lab, 
            aes(x = 0.004, y = 0.00001, label = label),
            hjust = 0, vjust = 0, size = 3, inherit.aes = FALSE) +
       theme_bw(base_size = 12)
plot(ggp)
#ggsave("figures/S2_genus_corr.svg", ggp, width = 12, height = 6)
```
### Create relative abundance and metadata dataframes with the mean samples
```{r}
genus_ra_with_mean <- genus_norm %>% tibble::rownames_to_column("genus") %>% 
                      left_join(patient_genus_ra_mean_wide %>% tibble::rownames_to_column("genus") , by = "genus") %>% 
                      tibble::column_to_rownames("genus")

core_mdata_mean_samples <- data.frame(sample_id = colnames(patient_genus_ra_mean_wide)) %>% 
                           mutate(patient_id = gsub("_mean", "", sample_id), 
                                  batch = "Mean RA") %>%
                           left_join(core_mdata %>% select(-sample_id, -batch) %>% unique(), by = "patient_id")
core_mdata_with_mean <- rbind(core_mdata, core_mdata_mean_samples)
```

### Visualize the new PCoA plot with the mean samples
PCoA is a distance takes in accont the distances between all samples, so the mean samples should fall around (but not nessecarily exactly in) the middle of the samples of the same patient.
```{r, fig.width=6, fig.height=4}
genus_dist <- vegan::vegdist(genus_ra_with_mean %>% t(), method = "bray") %>% as.matrix()
result <- plot_pcoa_2d(genus_dist,core_mdata_with_mean, palette, return_plots = T)
pcoa_df <- result[[1]]

result[[3]] 
#ggsave("figures/s2_pcoa_phenotype.svg", result[[2]],width = 6, height = 4)
#ggsave("figures/s2_pcoa_subject.svg", result[[3]] +  guides(color = guide_legend(ncol = 2, byrow = TRUE)),width = 7, height = 4)
```

```{r}
genus_ra_only_mean <- genus_ra_with_mean %>% select(-cross_batch_samples) 
pcoa_df <- plot_pcoa_2d(genus_ra_only_mean %>% t() %>%

```


### Filter out rare genera and plot the PCoA
```{r}
genus_ra_only_mean_filt <- remove_rare_features(t(genus_ra_only_mean),
                                                prevalence_cutoff = 0.1,
                                                avg_abundance_cutoff = 0.001,
                                                rescale = T) %>% t() %>% as.data.frame()
ggdata <- genus_ra_only_mean_filt  %>% t() %>% vegan::vegdist(method = "bray") %>% as.matrix()
pcoa_df <- plot_pcoa_2d(ggdata, core_mdata_with_mean, palette)
```

```{r, fig.width=12, fig.height=10}
ggdata <- patient_genus %>% select(-sample_id) %>% filter(genus %in% rownames(genus_ra_only_mean_filt)) %>% 
          group_by(patient_id, batch) %>% mutate(ra = ra/sum(ra)) %>% ungroup() %>% 
          tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = batch, values_from = ra)

person_corr_lab <- manual_corr_calc_for_plot(ggdata)
print( person_corr_lab %>% summarise(mean(r_raw)))

ggp <- ggplot(ggdata, aes(x = `Batch 22`, y = `Batch 24`)) + geom_point() + 
       geom_abline(intercept = 0, slope = 1) + 
       scale_x_log10() + scale_y_log10() +
       facet_wrap(~patient_id, scales = "free") + 
        geom_text(data = person_corr_lab,

            hjust = 0, vjust = 0, size = 3, inherit.aes = FALSE) +

plot(ggp)
```

```{r}
metadata <- sample_metadata %>% filter(phenotype != "Fatty Liver") 
pathways <- read.delim("qiime/combined/7_PICRUST2/pathways_out/path_abun_unstrat_descrip.tsv", sep ="\t", header = T) %>%
            mutate(pathway = gsub("-","_", pathway))
pathway_meaning <- pathways %>% select(pathway,description)
pathway_meaning_list = c(pathway_meaning$description)
names(pathway_meaning_list) = pathway_meaning$pathway

pathways <- pathways %>% select(-description) %>% tibble::column_to_rownames("pathway")
colnames(pathways) <- format_sample_ids(colnames(pathways))

shared_samples <-dplyr::intersect(metadata$sample_id, colnames(pathways))
metadata <- metadata %>% filter(sample_id %in% shared_samples)
pathways <- pathways %>% select(all_of(shared_samples)) #%>% scale(center = TRUE, scale = TRUE) %>% as.data.frame()
pathways <- sweep(pathways, 2, colSums(pathways), FUN = "/") # calculate relative abundance
```


```{r}
pathways_dist <- pathways %>% t() %>%  dist(.,method = "euclidean") %>% as.matrix()
pcoa_df <- plot_pcoa_2d(pathways_dist,core_mdata, palette)
```

```{r}
                    tibble::rownames_to_column("sample_id") %>%
                    tidyr::pivot_longer(cols = -sample_id, names_to = "pathway", values_to = "ra") %>%

                         mutate(patient_id = paste0(patient_id,"_mean")) %>%  ungroup()
patient_pw_ra_mean_wide <- patient_pw_ra_mean %>% tidyr::spread(pathway, mean_ra) %>%

pathway_ra_with_mean <- pathways %>% tibble::rownames_to_column("pathway") %>%

```
```{r}
pathway_dist <-pathway_ra_with_mean %>% t() %>% dist(.,method = "euclidean") %>% as.matrix()

```


```{r, fig.width=12, fig.height=10}
ggdata <- patient_pw %>% select(-sample_id) %>% 
          tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = batch, values_from = ra)

person_corr_lab <- manual_corr_calc_for_plot(ggdata)

ggp <- ggplot(ggdata, aes(x = `Batch 22`, y = `Batch 24`)) + geom_point() + 
       geom_abline(intercept = 0, slope = 1) + 
       facet_wrap(~patient_id, ) + 
      geom_text(data = person_corr_lab,
            aes(y = 0.0025, x =0.01, label = label),
            hjust = 0, vjust = 0, size = 3, inherit.aes = FALSE) +
       theme_bw(base_size = 12)
plot(ggp)
```

On one hand, functional profiles of the same patient across batches are very strongly correlated (R = 0.97) 
with no clear bias towards one of the batches. On the other hand, for some patients batch correcting the data would cause major shift is the PCoA space. 
In addition, the two remaining patients which are unique to batch 24 are located in the same area of the PCoA space as the rest of the FAP patients, so they do not seem to be outliers.
As a result, I decided to use the data from batch 22 (when available) because this is the larger batch, and use the new samples from batch 24 as they are. 

```{r}
batch_22_samples <- metadata %>% filter(batch == "Batch 22") %>% pull(sample_id)
batch_24_samples_to_keep <- metadata %>% filter(batch == "Batch 24", !sample_id %in% sample_map$sample_id) %>% pull(sample_id)
samples_to_keep <- c(batch_22_samples, batch_24_samples_to_keep)
pathways <- pathways %>% select(all_of(samples_to_keep))
```
